slot_note: re-root after architecture 5 landed on the platform; a new domain and objective
niche: a municipal utility's commercial building retrofit grants, recruited from its annual gas benchmarking notices, judged on verified normal-weather gas savings
analyst_test: A strong analyst who cleans the meter reads and reads the council's rule correctly verifies each past retrofit's saving as its weather-normalised gas use (degree days at the standard 15 degree heating limit) before against after, confirms it against customers who took no grant, and funds every pipeline building whose grant then clears the cost-per-tonne limit, a far larger round than the savings support.
domain_test: The call turns on a retrofit's verified gas saving in a normal-weather year, which energy measurement and verification takes from metered use regressed on heating degree days at each building's own balance point; with another field's nouns there is no heating limit that the retrofit itself lowers and no weather year to normalise to.
layer1: meter points re-keyed at meter exchanges
billing periods not aligned to calendar months
tenant changes on the same building
a weather station gap filled from a neighbour
stakeholder_role: head of energy services at the municipal utility
driver: The decisive quantity is the effect of a treatment on units enrolled because a noisy yearly measure of them ran high, so their own before-and-after fall carries that measure's regression and only units flagged by the same measure and left untreated give the counterfactual; the outcome is normalised to a reference exposure through a threshold each unit sets and the treatment itself moves, so a common threshold misstates the change whenever the after years' exposure differs.
driver_concrete: Haldenau's retrofit grants went to commercial buildings whose gas use the utility's benchmarking notice flagged as high the year before, so their before-and-after fall includes the regression of that high year, which buildings flagged the same year without a grant also show; and gas use is normalised to a normal winter through each building's own heating limit, which insulation lowers, so the standard 15 degree limit overstates the saving in the mild winters after the works.
stump: A competent solver verifies each past retrofit's saving as its weather-normalised gas use (degree days at the standard 15 degree heating limit) in the year before the works against the years after, sees the saving confirmed against customers who took no grant, and funds most of the 2027 pipeline; the step that lands it there is taking the flagged year as the baseline, when the buildings were enrolled because that year ran high and flagged buildings without a grant fall nearly as far, and normalising every building at one heating limit that the insulation itself lowers.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how many of the period's placeable units a fixed team can finish before the period closes, because each unit counts only once that team performs one last step for it, the team's spare weekly capacity is visible only as the ceiling it held through an earlier unrelated surge, and the decision's own volume, bunched by its filed calendar into weeks no closed period approached, queues the later units past the close; the closed record's lag and an annual capacity check both pass, so the placeable count overstates the in-period total wherever the team is small and the units are many.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a forward total projected from a history of cumulative progress by age in which the units carrying most of the amount began resolving more slowly partway through the record; the share of the amount settled tracks the share of units resolved rather than age, so the history has to be restated at the resolution shares the latest observations show before its age-to-age ratios are carried forward, and carrying them unrestated, or taking them from the latest periods alone, understates the total.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the part of each unit's recorded wait that the offered intervention removes, because the recorded wait fuses the step the intervention replaces with a concurrent step it leaves in place, so only the replaced step's excess over the concurrent one, built by joining separate operational logs, counts; ranking units by the recorded wait, or by the replaced step measured from the same start, credits the units whose concurrent step is slowest.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is what preventing one unit's failure removes across a population of units, when some units draw most of their inflow from that unit and in the population's own record failed at a high rate within months of their main payer's failure, so a value read on the unit's own expected loss misses the failures it would set off; the dependence comes from the flows between units and the conditional failure rate from the population's past failures, neither stored in any field.
